chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id, from Muhammad ibn al-Fudayl, from Abi al-Sabbah, who said:
I asked Aba 'Abdillah عليه السلام about the takbir in the two Eids. He said: Twelve takbirs: seven in the first [rak'ah] and five in the latter.

key_terms.التَّكْبِيرِ: the utterance of 'Allahu Akbar' within the ritual prayer
key_terms.الْآخِرَةِ: the latter, meaning the second rak'ah
key_terms.الْأُولَى: the first rak'ah of the Eid prayer
key_terms.الْعِيدَيْنِ: the two Eid festivals, Eid al-Fitr and Eid al-Adha
key_terms.خَمْسٌ: five, referring to the takbirs in the second rak'ah
key_terms.سَبْعٌ: seven, referring to the takbirs in the first rak'ah

ai.seo_question: How many takbirs are recited in Salat al-Eid according to Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith states the number of takbirs in the salat of the two Eids. Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام explains that they are twelve in total, with seven in the first rak'ah and five in the second, making it a concise legal ruling on the form of Eid prayer.
